title: What are the sums of these eight pairs of decimals?
description: Eight pairs of decimals are added by lining up the point, filling empty places with zero and carrying, the same way as the example in the book.
teaching_notes: One idea: line up the point, fill empty places with zero, and add from the right. Watch for children who line up the last digits instead of the point.

source: Figure it Out (adding and subtracting decimals), Q1
video_script.why: The child has added two decimals with carries and now adds eight pairs, some with different lengths.
video_script.substitution: Line up the point, fill empty places with zero, and add from the right with carries.
video_script.anchor: Eight pairs of decimals written in a place table, one pair at a time.
video_script.payoff_line: Line up the point, add from the right, and carry tens

final_answer.spoken: seven point nine, twenty six point eight, seven point four one, eighteen point one one, thirty nine point one zero, one point five three four, zero point seven eight and six point seven two three

maths_rules: check: whole parts total <= sum < whole parts total + 2 in every pair
video_script.design: One place table stays on screen. Each pair is written into it, and the carries travel up in one colour.

beats.on_screen: title card From your book; eight pairs of decimals to add

marks.ask: a plus sign joins each pair

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book.
<bookmark mark='pairs'/>Eight pairs of decimals are given on the board.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Find the sum of each pair.

beats.on_screen: the eight pairs stay on the board
narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: one point above the other; empty places filled with zero; add from the right

marks.same: the example in the book appears beside this question
marks.add: an arrow runs from right to left

narration: <bookmark mark='same'/>We solve this the same way as the example in your book.
<bookmark mark='line'/>Write one point exactly above the other, and fill empty places with zero.
<bookmark mark='add'/>Add from the right, and carry ten of a place to the next.

marks.given: the eight additions are written in a list

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, eight pairs of decimals, written in a list.

beats.on_screen: To find: the sum of each pair
narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the sum of each pair.

beats.on_screen: (a) tenths 3 + 6 = 9, units 5 + 2 = 7; (b) 18 as 18.0: tenths 0 + 8 = 8, units 8 + 8 = 16, tens 1 + 1 = 2

marks.a1: the first pair is added column by column
marks.b1: a zero is written after eighteen
marks.b2: the carry moves to the tens column

narration: <bookmark mark='a1'/>Step one, take five point three plus two point six. Tenths: three plus six is nine, then units: five plus two is seven.
<bookmark mark='b1'/>Next, eighteen plus eight point eight. Write eighteen as eighteen point zero, then tenths: zero plus eight is eight.
<bookmark mark='b2'/>Units: eight plus eight is sixteen. Write six and carry one, then tens: one plus one is two.

beats.on_screen: (c) hundredths 5 + 6 = 11, tenths 1 + 2 + 1 = 4, units 2 + 5 = 7; (d) hundredths 1 + 0 = 1, tenths 0 + 1 = 1, units 9 + 9 = 18

marks.c1: the hundredths column is added and the carry is shown
marks.c2: the tenths and units columns are added
marks.d1: the second pair is added in the hundredths and tenths columns
marks.d2: the units column is added and the one moves to the tens

narration: <bookmark mark='c1'/>Step two, take two point one five plus five point two six. Hundredths: five plus six is eleven. Write one and carry one.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Tenths: one plus two plus one is four, then units: two plus five is seven.
<bookmark mark='d1'/>Next, nine point zero one plus nine point one zero. Hundredths: one plus zero is one, then tenths: zero plus one is one.
<bookmark mark='d2'/>Units: nine plus nine is eighteen. Write eight, and the one goes to the tens.

marks.e1: the hundredths column is added and a carry is shown
marks.e2: the tenths column is added and a carry is shown
marks.e3: the units and tens columns are added

narration: <bookmark mark='e1'/>Step three, take twenty nine point one nine plus nine point nine one. Hundredths: nine plus one is ten. Write zero and carry one.
<bookmark mark='e2'/>Tenths: one plus nine plus one is eleven. Write one and carry one.
<bookmark mark='e3'/>Units: nine plus nine plus one is nineteen. Write nine and carry one, then tens: two plus one is three.

marks.f1: zeroes are written after zero point six
marks.f2: the tenths column is added and the carry is shown
marks.f3: the carried one lands in the units column
marks.g1: the next pair is added in the hundredths and tenths columns

narration: <bookmark mark='f1'/>Step four, take zero point nine three four plus zero point six. Write zero point six as zero point six zero zero.
<bookmark mark='f2'/>Thousandths: four, then hundredths: three, then tenths: nine plus six is fifteen. Write five and carry one.
<bookmark mark='f3'/>Units: only the carried one is there.
<bookmark mark='g1'/>Next, zero point seven five plus zero point zero three. Hundredths: five plus three is eight, then tenths: seven plus zero is seven.

marks.h1: the thousandths column is added and a carry is shown
marks.h2: the hundredths column is added and a carry is shown
marks.h3: the tenths and units columns are added

narration: <bookmark mark='h1'/>Step five, take six point two three six plus zero point four eight seven. Thousandths: six plus seven is thirteen. Write three and carry one.
<bookmark mark='h2'/>Hundredths: three plus eight plus one is twelve. Write two and carry one.
<bookmark mark='h3'/>Tenths: two plus four plus one is seven, then units: six.

beats.on_screen: check: whole parts total <= sum < whole parts total + 2, in every pair

marks.chk: a tick appears beside each sum
marks.two: the upper limit is shown for each sum

narration: <bookmark mark='chk'/>Step six, check with the whole parts. Each sum is at least the total of the whole parts.
<bookmark mark='two'/>It is also less than two more than that total.

marks.v1: the first two sums are ticked
marks.v2: the next two sums are ticked
marks.v3: the fifth and sixth sums are ticked
marks.v4: the last two sums are ticked

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Line up the point, add from the right, and carry tens.
<bookmark mark='v1'/>The first two sums are seven point nine and twenty six point eight.
<bookmark mark='v2'/>The next two are seven point four one and eighteen point one one.
<bookmark mark='v3'/>Then thirty nine point one zero, and one point five three four.
<bookmark mark='v4'/>The last two are zero point seven eight and six point seven two three.
